# Alson PM Control
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Operates a project's living control records and tailored PMI process work. The skill keeps source documents in their original locations and stores only project-control state, drafts, traceability, and approved records.

## Install

From the project repository where the skill should run:

```bash
alson install alson-pm-control
```

Start a new agent session after installation. Skills are discovered when the session starts.

## Use

Invoke it explicitly when you want PM Control to govern the request:

```text
Use the alson-pm-control workspace.
```

Then use plain English:

```text
Help me set up project control for Project Alpha.
My project documents are in /projects/project-alpha.
```

```text
What needs my attention?
```

```text
Check the RAID.
```

```text
Capture the risks from these meeting notes.
```

```text
Run Identify Risks.
```

```text
Assess this change request. Do not approve it.
```

## Approval Boundary

PM Control prepares a process run through validation and review. It stops before reconciliation and asks for explicit PM direction.

The PM must direct the skill before it closes items, approves changes or decisions, assigns ownership, changes scope or baselines, accepts deliverables, escalates, or enters the reconciliation stage.

## What It Does Not Do

- It does not replace project source documents.
- It does not invent missing evidence.
- It does not run a full artifact baseline during project setup.
- It does not silently close or approve project-control items.
- It does not replace the formal status-report, project-health, daily-priority, or status-update-reconciliation skills unless PM Control is explicitly invoked.
